|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">DS-61-4がヤヴィンの戦いで搭乗したタイ・ファイター。乱戦の中で、ルークのレッド5に一撃を加えた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Black 4.

'''Card text:'''
May add 1 pilot. If a battle is declared against any TIE, may deploy with a pilot as a “react.” If the TIE is Black 2 or Black 3, there is no deploy cost. Must have a pilot aboard to use power and maneuver.

'''Lore:'''
The TIE fighter DS-61-4 flew at the Battle of Yavin. In the melee it scored a hit on Luke's Red 5.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore names Luke's Red 5. Printed subtype is TIE／LN.
